run_render_video: run render_video to create an FFmpeg video from block and depth binary observation files in a directory
run_cli_video_render: run the CLI with --logdir, --outfile, and --player-name to render a player's Minecraft observations into a video
create_render_video_function: create a function that reads block and depth binary files and renders them side by side into an FFmpeg video
review_render_video: review the render_video function that reads 128x128 block and depth frames and writes them to an MP4 video file
refactor_render_video_max_depth: refactor render_video to parameterize the max_depth clipping threshold for depth visualization
